subject: Upcoming Travel Booking Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to inform you that your upcoming travel booking has been successfully confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Departure: [Date and Time] from [Airport] Arrival: [Date and Time] at [Destination Airport] Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before the departure time. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Travel Agency Team
